subject: drawn-gesture-command-recognition
seam: Gestures/SigilRecognizerSubsystem.cpp HandleHandFrame feeds every frame with an index tip to FSigilStrokeBuilder::AddTip and never reads Frame.Confidence; the clip player's tracking drop keeps emitting confidence-0 frames, and the session pause waits trackingLossS 1.5 s. Nothing aborts or bridges a stroke across a loss.
instrument: line-for-line JS port of FSigilStrokeBuilder (both styles) over tools/glyphs/stroke.mjs fitPlane and tools/glyphs/qdollar.mjs, templates extracted from Game/Clips/templates, corpus from generate.mjs --corpus 30 --seed 1000 + mousepaths.mjs. Positive control: 83/83 of the thresholds MageArena.Sigils.Templates/Accuracy/NoFalseCasts assert (corpus 257/270, mouse 87/90, impostors 30/30 each, 0 noise casts over 180 s). Perturbation: one loss inside the first attempt at 20/40/60/80% of its span, 360 clips x 4 onsets = 1,440 trials per length, as held pose (conf 0) and as dropped frames.
arms: A = as is. B = technique step 4 as written: conf < 0.2 (the tree's own tracked floor) is a missing sample, a gap of <= 3 samples is bridged, a longer one aborts the attempt and the pen must lift before the next stroke. B' = the same gate with the bridge set at 15 samples (208 ms), read off A's curve.
target: wrong-line casts caused by a loss. Style A, held pose (dropped frames identical within 3 trials): 0 ms 64 wrong of 1,440 (precision 95.6%); 100 ms 72 (95.0%); 200 ms 72 (95.0%); 300 ms 162 (88.4%); 400 ms 207 (75.0%); 600 ms 235 (53.9%); 800 ms 92 of 251 casts (63.3%). B and B' cast 0 wrong past their bridge.
floor: unperturbed suite identical in all arms (corpus 257/270, mouse 87/90, impostors 180/180 rejected, 0 noise casts): the corpus's own 3-frame confidence dips sit at 0.4, above the floor. Correct casts under a loss: B loses 1,368 of 1,368 correct casts at 100 ms and again at 200 ms to stop 72 wrong ones, of which only 8 exceed the unperturbed 64, so the floor fell and B is not-better. B' equals A within 3 of 1,440 trials up to 200 ms and refuses everything from 300 ms, trading 1,240 correct for 162 wrong at 300 ms and 275 correct for 235 wrong at 600 ms.
chosen_to_falsify: a resampling point-cloud matcher ignores point order and spacing, so a stroke joined across a short loss could be harmless, which is the case step 4 forbids. It was: a 200 ms loss (a 9.7 cm chord) moved precision by 0.6 points. Step 4's 'a few samples' is too tight by about 5x for this matcher.
also: Speed pen (Style B, set only by tests): a held pose reads as stillness and ends the stroke, so a 200 ms held loss produced 166 casts (29 wrong) from clips that cast 0 unperturbed, and the 15-sample bridge removed all 166. Style B extracts all 270 corpus clips, but every one classifies at 56k-117k against the 26k floor, plausibly because its cloud carries the reach-in while the templates are pinch-drawn (not isolated). MageArena.Sigils.Templates checks only that Style B extracts.
next: if the pinch pen keeps the 1.5 s session pause as its only loss handling, gate HandleHandFrame on Confidence with a bridge near 0.2 s (B') and an aborted event the HUD can show as a fizzle; whether a 300-600 ms loss should cast at 88-54% precision or fizzle is a design call, not a measurement.
open: synthetic only: the loss model assumes the hand keeps drawing while untracked, and no recorded hand has a real dropout yet. Return: the first recorded hands corpus with confidence dips; re-read the knee on it before choosing the bridge.

subject: hand-tracked-timing-windows
seam: Gestures/WardDetector.cpp FWardDetector::Ingest never reads Frame.Confidence: a raise, its freshness and the palm-speed onset walk are all built from whatever pose arrives. ward-raise.sloppy already dips to conf 0.4 for 3 frames at the start of the rise, and the clip player tracking drop keeps emitting real poses at conf 0 (HandClipPlayer.cpp:197). The tree has one confidence floor, 0.2, in the both-palms gate (SessionFlow.cpp:518).
instrument: line-for-line JS port of FWardDetector (Ingest, FindOnset, FHeldPointRate) and FAbsorbResolver::Resolve over the committed clips. Positive control: 22/22 values of the suite own Saved/Reports/ward-timing.json (geometric onset, authored onset and confirm, and confirm/onset/perfect at 0-100 ms injected latency). Corpus: 28 fresh raises (ward-raise normal/sloppy/slow, the settle clip, 24 raises of noise-ward). Perturbation: one confidence dip of 3 or 6 samples starting 12 frames before to 2 after the confirm frame, at conf 0.4/0.1/0, with the pose during the dip true, held (last pose re-sent), jittered (1 cm per joint, 5 seeds) or a coherent wrong guess (hand rotated 20-60 deg, 5 seeds): 9,960 trials per arm per conf level. Magic hits in arc on a 1 ms grid from onset-0.05 to onset+0.6, judged two ways: horizon (onset-judged once classification is in, as the tests do) and live (window opens at the raise event, as ArenaThreats does via AbsorbFreshTick).
arms: A = as is. B-3/B-8 = technique as its procedure reads: hysteresis 0.3 enter / 0.2 leave (0.2 is the tree own floor, 0.3 a guess; no reference rig, so both are labelled guesses), a raise or lower is only decided on a trusted sample, an untrusted in-pose sample opens a deferral of 3 or 8 samples, expiry withholds freshness. C-8 = B-8 plus the timing half: an untrusted sample measures nothing, carrying the last trusted speed and height as a held sample does, and the next trusted sample is measured across the gap.
target: phantom perfect time (perfect where the clean clip gives none), as % of clean perfect time, dips below the floor, horizon resolver: A 1.8-4.7%; B-8 1.3-5.4% (not moved); C-8 0.2-0.5%. Held pose over 6 samples: A and B 80.5% lost / 80.1% phantom (the hold outlives MaxHoldS 0.05 and reads as stillness, so the onset jumps to the reappearance); C-8 0.4/0.5. Rewards decided on a sample under 0.2: A 81-1062 trials per cell, every gated arm 0 - including B, whose phantoms did not move.
floor: perfect time kept, tolerance 1%: clean clips and conf-0.4 dips identical in all arms. True-pose dips (the tracker was right), horizon: B-8 0.0% lost, C-8 0.2-0.4%, B-3 20.3% lost at 6-sample dips (81 of 415 trials lose the perfect: expiry withholds the reward from a correct raise). Live resolver: every gated arm loses 3.9% (3-sample) and 13.4% (6-sample) of perfect AND guard time on true dips, because a deferral moves the raise event the live window opens at, and hits inside it land unguarded.
chosen_to_falsify: the technique says a deferral costs the player nothing because onset time does not move while the game waits, and that a reward from below the floor should be impossible. The live session judges at the raise event, so the first claim could break here; and the tests judge on onset, so the second claim could be met without moving anything. Both happened: deferral is free only under an onset-judged verdict with a horizon, and the sub-floor count reads zero for an eligibility-only gate whose phantom rate did not move.
next: if the ward gains a confidence gate, gate the onset walk too (C-8: untrusted samples are held, not measured) and size the deferral from the device dip lengths, not from a few samples. Do not ship it while the session opens the perfect window at the raise event: there a deferral costs 13% of guard time on 83 ms dips. Ship order: onset in the live session first (the open return condition on hand-tracked-timing-windows), then C-8.
open: synthetic poses and a modelled error-versus-confidence curve: no recorded hand has a real dip yet, and the per-hand confidence carries no per-joint detail. Return: V1 device corpus with isActive and confidence per frame (PROJECT-PLAN V1, 4 Nov); re-read the dip-length distribution and the pose error per confidence band before choosing the floor and the bound.

subject: drawn-gesture-command-recognition
seam: apps/vr/Game/Source/MageArenaVR/Tests/SigilTests.cpp MageArena.Sigils.Accuracy: top1 bars (0.95 normal and slow, 0.90 sloppy and mouse) are applied to the three classes pooled inside a variant
instrument: apps/vr/tools/vocab-audit/audit.mjs on the project own JS ports (tools/glyphs/qdollar.mjs, stroke.mjs); positive control: it reproduces the C++ header numbers exactly (correct max 23595, bare circles min 13084, open arcs min 49796, zigzag min 4271) and the pooled sloppy 82/90
arms: A the pooled gate as it is; B the same bars cut per class and per variant, with the other four audit steps (pairwise template distance, shared-prefix share, quarter-turn pairs, negative proximity) read beside it
target: class cells under their own bar that the gate can see: A 0 of 12, B 2 of 12 (synthetic sloppy horizontal 24/30 = 80%, six read as diagonal; synthetic normal diagonal 28/30 = 93%). Inner mark is 9-10% of the drawn path, vertical rotated 90 degrees sits 2178 from a horizontal template, closer than any unrotated cross-class pair (3196)
floor: pooled gate unchanged and still met on the same corpus (sloppy 82/90, normal 87/90); no product code or threshold touched; 12 baseline cells ratchet green on HEAD; mutation (drop the 12 sloppy templates) turns the check red (4 cells drop, 1 gains)
chosen_to_falsify: yes: the claim that the existing confusion matrix already covers step 4. It prints the full 3x4 matrix but gates only pooled top1, and the pooled sloppy bar is met by one clip (82 against 81)
next: a human decision on the horizontal/diagonal pair: the diagonal sits at 45 degrees, midway between the other two, and the technique says change a shape, not the reject distance. Not tested here: no angle sweep, because clipgen has no diagonal-angle knob and generate.mjs rewrites tracked clips
open: synthetic corpus only (seeded procedural hand), no person drew any stroke; projection is the JS port not the engine; UE tests not run. Return: V1 device corpus (PROJECT-PLAN V1) re-run of audit.mjs, and a cell under its bar on real hands decides whether the 45 degree diagonal stays.

subject: sound-effect-generation
seam: apps/vr/tools/sfx/generate.mjs and art/audio/sfx/cues.json: every one of the 20 cues is one composite text -> one take; crest, perfect-absorb, fire-impact and unblockable-telegraph each ask a single call for weight, definition and size at once, and the only repair for a bad axis is --force (reroll the whole take)
target: paid requests per accepted multi-axis cue, and the share of accepted cues needing a whole-cue reroll for one failed axis
floor: the 20 existing cues untouched (cues.json and wavs unchanged); loop-seam and format self-test still pass
shipped: first step only: mixLayers() assembly primitive (trim to attack, per-layer delay and gain, unnormalised sum, then the normal convertFile peak normalise) with a self-test on synthetic stems: attack alignment across a late-starting low layer and a -12 dB transient. Not wired to cues.json and no layered cue defined
chosen_to_falsify: the technique claims layers align at the attack with ordinary mix work; a stem with leading silence would offset the stack by that silence, and the tree trimmed silence only per finished cue. The test fails (0.9 s, not 0.6 s) if the per-stem trim is dropped
open: no paid render: layered quality needs real takes (4 calls for one cue) and a blind listen against the composite, not run unattended. Return: owner approves a one-cue spend (crest or perfect-absorb), then count requests and listen blind. Next step: cues.json layers[] schema and the generation loop per layer (keep winners, --force <cue>:<role>).

subject: cinematic-language
seam: apps/vr/art/style-studies/prompts.json and apps/vr/art/vfx-concepts/prompts.json: lighting lives only in each style_block; the 36 per-scene prompts carry no darkness clause and no named in-world source with direction
target: scene prompts carrying source+direction+darkness: 0 of 36 (darkness clause 0 of 36)
floor: style-pick comparability: the three shortlisted styles must be rendered from identical scene text, so a darkness clause has to be added to all three arms or none
open: render arm owed: one scene (01-vr-duel) per style with a shared darkness clause vs none, same seed, operator blind pick. Prompts left untouched: images exist and the 19 Oct style pick is pending, so editing them mid-pick would change the thing being judged.
return: after the style pick, when the winning style gets its production scene prompts
